calculators.title: TVM worksheet (N, I/Y, PV, PMT, FV)
calculators.description: Fill any four and solve the fifth, as on a BA II Plus. Money received is positive, money paid is negative: a loan taken is PV +, its EMI is PMT −. Covers lump sums, SIPs, loans, annuities and annuities due.
calculators.keywords: tvm pv fv pmt nper rate emi sip lump sum annuity due present future value ba ii plus

calculators.title: Annuities and perpetuities
calculators.description: Present and future value of level, growing and deferred annuities, perpetuities and growing perpetuities. The rate and growth are per payment period.
calculators.keywords: annuity perpetuity growing gordon deferred present value pension

fields.label: Payment (first payment for a growing one)
Periods before the first payment period
fields.hint: First payment at the end of period deferral + 1

calculators.title: Simple and compound interest
calculators.description: Interest on a sum for any number of years, simple and compound, with the same rate under every compounding side by side.
calculators.keywords: simple compound interest continuous compounding amount fd

fields.label: Years
fields.hint: Decimals allowed: 2.5 is two and a half years

calculators.title: Effective rate for any period
calculators.description: Convert between nominal (APR), effective annual (EAR), continuous, and rates per day, week, month, quarter, half-year or any number of days.
calculators.keywords: effective annual rate ear apr nominal convert monthly quarterly daily periodic continuous

options.label: Rate for a number of days (holding period)

calculators.title: Real and nominal rates, inflation
calculators.description: The real return after inflation (Fisher), and what an amount costs, or is worth in today's money, after some years of inflation.
calculators.keywords: real nominal inflation fisher purchasing power cost future today money

calculators.title: Money market yields (T-bills, CDs, CPs)
calculators.description: From the price, or any one yield, get every other: holding period, bank discount, money market, bond-equivalent and effective annual yield.
calculators.keywords: t-bill treasury bill cd commercial paper discount yield bdy mmy hpy eay bey money market

calculators.title: Flat rate vs reducing-balance rate
calculators.description: A flat rate charges interest on the full loan for the whole term. See the reducing-balance rate it really costs, or the flat rate that matches a reducing rate.
calculators.keywords: flat rate reducing balance consumer loan personal loan emi true rate add-on

calculators.title: Doubling time (rule of 72)
calculators.description: How long money takes to double (or grow any number of times) at a rate, or the rate needed to do it in a given time, with the rules of thumb beside the exact answer.
calculators.keywords: rule of 72 69 double doubling time triple grow multiple

calculators.title: Cash flow worksheet (NPV, IRR, MIRR)
calculators.description: CF0 now, then CF1, CF2 … one period apart, each repeated as many times as you say (Fj), as on a BA II Plus. NPV, NFV, IRR (every one, when there are several), MIRR, payback, discounted payback, profitability index and equivalent annuity.
calculators.keywords: npv irr mirr nfv payback discounted profitability index cash flow worksheet capital budgeting eaa

fields.label: Periods per year
fields.hint: To show IRR as an annual rate when the periods are months or quarters

calculators.title: Dated cash flows (XNPV, XIRR)
calculators.description: Cash flows on any dates: SIP instalments and today's value, a property bought and sold, irregular deposits. Annual XIRR and XNPV as in Excel (Actual/365).
calculators.keywords: xirr xnpv dated irregular cash flows sip returns annualised

fields.label: Dated cash flows
fields.hint: Paid out negative; today's value as received

calculators.title: Days between dates
calculators.description: Actual days, years-months-days and 30/360 day counts between two dates, or a date some months and days away (31 Jan + 1 month is the end of February).
calculators.keywords: date days between 30/360 day count calendar add months maturity

fields.label: Months to add (negative to go back)
Days to add (negative to go back)

calculators.title: Percentages, markup and GST
calculators.description: Percentage change, a percentage of a number, markup on cost against margin on price, and tax added to or taken out of an amount.
calculators.keywords: percent percentage change markup margin gst tax inclusive exclusive
